_warning: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT. Built from the CSV by scripts/data/build-data.mjs; edits are lost on the next build. Edit the CSV, then run: npm run data:build

manufacturer_slug.note: The stocking retailer's own slug in manufacturers.csv. Named manufacturer_slug rather than slug because this file describes a retailer viewed as a supplier, and 013_sourcing.sql exposes it to listings as retailer_slug via m.slug. A column alias in SQL does not make it a different key, so this is the one a cross-dataset reference must target.

source_type.note: How the retailer sells. 'online' is a website; 'dealer' is a distributor or wholesaler rather than a shop a consumer visits.

ships_domestically.note: Whether it ships within its own country.

ships_to_regions.note: Comma-separated region codes it ships to, e.g. "US, CA, UK, EU". Free text rather than an enum because region boundaries differ between retailers and a retailer may ship to a country with no region code.

hazmat_shipping.note: Whether it ships flammable reloading components. Practically all do, but it is recorded because it is a real constraint on where a user can buy powder, and it is the kind of fact that should come from the retailer rather than be assumed.

directions.note: Street address, for a physical store.

region_code.note: State or province code, for a physical store.

affiliate_network.note: Which affiliate programme the retailer belongs to. NULL for every retailer today - the project README names AvantLink but also warns that several programmes have since migrated, and an unconfirmed network that is filled in anyway produces dead links.

network_store_id.note: The retailer's id within the affiliate network. Blank while affiliate_network is.

link_template.note: Search URL with a {search} placeholder, e.g. https://www.midwayusa.com/search/?q={search}. Almost always the site's own search form, because per-SKU deep links have not been captured. A URL with no {search} is a defect: it would send every query to one page.

feed_format.note: Machine-readable product feed the retailer publishes, if any. NULL for all retailers today; recorded so that "no feed" is a known answer rather than an unchecked one.

affiliate_status.note: State of the affiliate relationship. 'unknown' is an honest starting point, not a failure - it says nobody has checked, which is different from claiming there is no programme.

scraping_status.note: Whether this retailer's terms permit automated product lookup. Always 'unknown' today and deliberately so: 'allowed' must never be assumed, and the answer decides whether the component finder may query it at all.

notes.note: Free prose, and the place where the reasoning behind a blank lives. May contain commas; keep quoted.

rows.notes: Largest US reloading retailer; carries bullets, powders, primers, brass and loaded ammo. Link template is the site search form - no product-feed deep link captured yet. Affiliate network left NULL on purpose: the project README names AvantLink but also warns several programs have since migrated, so it is unconfirmed and must not be guessed.

Strong on reloading components and specialty bullets. Ships to the UK and EU, which matters for reach. Template is a site search; per-SKU URLs use a different path we have not captured. Affiliate network unconfirmed - see midwayusa note.

Known for in-stock reloading components and transparent inventory counts. One of the easiest retailers to verify stock against, which makes it a good first target for the scraper lane. Affiliate network unconfirmed - see midwayusa note.
General firearms retailer. Ammo and brass heavy, thinner on match bullets and powders than the specialist reloading houses. Carries a wide accessories range that a component finder can also surface.
Match-oriented and carries a good spread of premium bullets. Not a full reloading-supply house - powder availability in particular is limited.
One of the two houses that genuinely covers the whole reloading supply range: powders, primers, bullets, brass, scales and presses. A strong default for powder and primer queries.
Optics and accessories rather than reloading components. Included because the finder should still be able to surface a scope or mount for a given cartridge, but it is a weak source for components.
Firearms and accessories. Limited reloading component range; included for completeness of the directory rather than as a primary component source.
